about: Hand-written routing tasks: near misses across workflows, quick answers, open work and the lifecycle trigger. Each workflow's own example prompts (its routing.examples in workflow.json) are added to these at run time, so a new workflow brings its own tests. expect is start, offer, open, answer or lifecycle; workflow names the one a start or offer is for.

tasks.prompt: Can you tighten the wording of the opening paragraph of my launch plan? It says: 'We are going to be launching the new held payments experience in March which will help customers.'
Quick one: what's the difference between a requirement and a dependency?
Summarise this call for me in three bullets: the customer said they never know when held money will arrive, they called twice, and they'd switch banks if it happened again.
Write me a two-line Slack status: we're on track for the March 3 launch, design review is done.
Shape this slide title so it reads better: 'Held payments: what we are going to do about it going forward'.
I'm leaning towards the cheaper alerts vendor even though their SDK is newer. Talk me through it?
I keep hearing parents complain about held payments and I'm not sure what to make of it yet.
Let's brainstorm ways we could cut support calls about card limits.
Note for the record that we decided yesterday to ship release dates to card customers first. Just say it back to me in one sentence.
We've got six open questions on the release-dates work and steering is Thursday. I haven't decided any of them.
I exported forty support tickets about held payments and a dozen call notes. What's actually going on for these customers?
My VP wants to know by tomorrow whether the payments launch still lands on March 3. Two teams have gone quiet.
Can risk and design both look at the launch plan before Friday? I want their comments in one place.
Run a decision review on the release-dates work, please.
Catalogue the requirements in the held payments PRD for me.
I'm working on a new feature: release dates for card customers.
We're kicking off a new feature around held-payment alerts. Where do I start?
